cve_summary: In GPAC 0.7.1 and earlier, gf_text_get_utf8_line in media_tools/text_import.c in libgpac_static.a allows an out-of-bounds write because a certain -1 return value is mishandled.
docstring:
Summary: This code fragment processes a UTF-16 encoded string, converting it to a UTF-8 representation while handling endianness based on the `unicode_type` variable.

Parameters: N/A

Returns: None

Logic: The code begins by checking the endianness of the input based on the `unicode_type`. If it is big-endian, it processes the string differently than if it is little-endian. It swaps pairs of characters in the `szLine` array until it reaches the end of the string.

judge_vs_vulnerable.rationale: The candidate implementation only handles the case where `unicode_type == 2`, swapping pairs of characters to process the UTF-16 string. The reference implementation includes additional logic for `unicode_type == 3`, as well as further processing steps like converting to UTF-8 and handling input stream cleanup. These additional behaviors are not present in the candidate implementation, leading to a functional mismatch. The difference is not security-relevant but affects the correctness of the full UTF-16 to UTF-8 conversion.

judge_vs_fixed.rationale: The two implementations are identical in their logic and behavior. Both swap pairs of characters in the `szLine` array when `unicode_type` is 2, until they encounter a null-terminator in both positions. There is no observable difference in behavior for any input.
